# SandUI LLM Index

SandUI is a TypeScript UI Library of accessible React components for dashboards, SaaS products, microservices, and internal tools.

## How to use

- Install: `npm i @sandurtech/sandui`
- Import from package entrypoint: `import { SandButton, SandModal, SandInputGroup } from '@sandurtech/sandui'`
- Every component supports semantic HTML, forwarded refs, and package-ready composition.

## Components

### Actions
- `SandButton`: Primary action component. Props: `variant` (`primary | secondary | outline | success | failed`) plus standard button attributes.

### Data Display
- `SandCard`: Semantic content container. Props: `header`, `footer`, and article attributes.
- `SandBadge`: Inline status label. Props: `variant` (`primary | secondary | success | failed`) and span attributes.
- `SandDivider`: Semantic separator. Props: standard `hr` attributes.
- `SandTable`: Tabular data display. Props: `columns`, `data`, `onRowClick`, and table attributes.
- `SandTabs`: Tabbed content container. Props: `tabs`, `defaultTab`, `onTabChange`, and div attributes.
- `SandAccordion`: Collapsible content sections with WAI-ARIA compliance. Props: `items` (Array of `{ id, title, content, description?, icon? }`), `defaultOpen`, `allowMultiple`, and standard div attributes.
- `SandCodeBlock`: Code snippet viewer. Props: `code`, `language`, and pre attributes.
- `SandCodeTabs`: Keyboardable code tablist. Props: `tabs`, `defaultTab`, `onTabChange`, `className`.
- `SandProgress`: Progress indicator. Props: `value`, `max`, `label`, and div attributes.
- `SandLoader`: Loading spinner. Props: `size`, `label`, and div attributes.
- `SandSkeleton`: Placeholder loading shape. Props: `variant`, `width`, `height`, and div attributes.
- `SandIcon`: Icon component. Props: `name`, `size`, `color`, and span attributes.

### Forms
- `SandInput`: Base text input. Props: standard input attributes plus `error`.
- `SandInputGroup`: Labeled input wrapper. Props: `label`, `helperText`, `groupClassName`, and all `SandInput` props.
- `SandFormGroup`: Form group wrapper. Props: `label`, `helperText`, `error`, and div attributes.
- `SandCheckbox`: Checkbox control. Props: `label`, `description`, and input attributes.
- `SandRadio`: Radio control with keyboard arrow navigation. Props: `label`, `description`, and input attributes.
- `SandSwitch`: Switch control. Props: `label`, `description`, and input attributes.
- `SandChoiceGroup`: Choice container. Props: `label` and div attributes.

### Feedback
- `SandToast`: Live-region feedback message. Props: `heading`, `message`, `action`, `variant`.
- `SandSnackbar`: Compact live-region feedback message. Props: `message`, `action`, `variant`, `heading?`.
- `SandAlert`: Alert banner. Props: `variant`, `icon`, `title`, `description`, and div attributes.

### Navigation
- `SandBreadcrumbs`: Hierarchical navigation. Props: `items` with `{ label, href? }` and nav attributes.
- `SandPagination`: Paged navigation. Props: `currentPage`, `totalPages`, `onPageChange`, and nav attributes.
- `SandNavbar`: Navigation bar. Props: `items`, `logo`, `onItemClick`, and nav attributes.
- `SandDrawer`: Side navigation drawer. Props: `open`, `onClose`, `position`, and aside attributes.

### Overlays
- `SandModal`: Accessible dialog. Props: `open`, `onClose`, `title`, `description`, `footer`, `closeOnOverlay`, `initialFocusRef`. Static subcomponents: `Header`, `Body`, `Footer`, `Title`, `Description`.
- `SandTooltip`: Tooltip popup. Props: `content`, `position`, `delay`, and span attributes.

### Layout
- `SandContainer`, `SandHeader`, `SandToolLayout`, `SandToolPanel`, `SandResultPanel`: Layout primitives for structured interfaces.
- `SandBox`: Box primitive for layout composition. Props: `as`, `className`, and HTML attributes.
- `SandGrid`: CSS Grid layout. Props: `columns`, `gap`, `rows`, and div attributes.
- `SandStack`: Flexbox stack layout. Props: `direction`, `gap`, `align`, `justify`, and div attributes.

### Typography
- `SandTitle`: Heading component. Props: `level`, `as`, `className`, and heading attributes.
- `SandText`: Text component. Props: `as`, `className`, and p/span attributes.
- `SandCode`: Inline code component. Props: `className` and code attributes.

### Utilities
- `SandKBD`: Keyboard shortcut primitive. Props: standard `kbd` attributes.

## Documentation routes

- `/`: Introduction
- `/design-tokens`: Design Tokens
- `/typography`: Typography
- `/layout`: Layout Components (Container, Header, ToolLayout, ToolPanel, ResultPanel, Box, Grid, Stack)
- `/kbd`: SandKBD
- `/buttons`: SandButton
- `/inputs`: SandInput, SandInputGroup, SandFormGroup
- `/cards`: SandCard
- `/selection`: SandCheckbox, SandRadio, SandSwitch, SandChoiceGroup
- `/navigation`: SandBreadcrumbs, SandPagination, SandNavbar, SandDrawer
- `/table`: SandTable
- `/tabs`: SandTabs
- `/accordion`: SandAccordion
- `/code`: SandCodeBlock, SandCodeTabs
- `/status`: SandBadge, SandDivider, SandProgress, SandLoader, SandSkeleton, SandIcon
- `/notifications`: SandToast, SandSnackbar, SandAlert
- `/modals`: SandModal
- `/overlays`: SandTooltip
- `/utilities`: Utility Components
